references.finding: Fixed accounting modes and recognized event semantics are prerequisite requirements, not inferred from directory permissions.
Single-writer delegation applies to services/scopes; writable directories alone do not transfer ownership.
Delegate and DelegateSubgroup describe a candidate dedicated user-service boundary; local execution remains unproven.
Installed Bubblewrap is not a complete sandbox policy; arguments and actual confinement require separate proof.

scope: Read-only documents and current-user capability metadata; no memory counter reads, cgroup creation, service start or resource run.
